title: Full Moon in Virgo
tldr: A culmination and release point for the Virgo / Pisces axis.
theme: This Full Moon illuminates routine, discernment, repair, health, craft, and the small actions that make devotion real through the Virgo side of the axis, while the Sun in Pisces asks for integration rather than extremes.
shadow: perfectionism as self-harm, over-correcting yourself until there is no room to live
integration: building a humane structure that supports excellence without cruelty

twoWeekArc.teaching: This arc shows where structure will set the dream free.
twoWeekArc.appPrompt: Name what the last two weeks revealed. Release the pattern that blocks the Virgo / Pisces balance point.

sixMonthArc.appPrompt: Look back to the same-sign New Moon. What took root because you tended it, and what grew because the soil was left untended?

ritual.function: illumination, release, cleansing, integration, and completion
ritual.timing: Use after the exact Full Moon when possible. Keep eclipse lunations under the separate witness protocol, not ordinary release ritual.
ritual.materials: Mercury kamea, yellow or white candle, agate or clear quartz, feather, water, and a list or journal page.
ritual.simpleSubstitution: A white candle, water, paper, and a quiet place are enough.
ritual.action: Write what is complete, what is ready to be released, and how the higher expression of Virgo can be embodied without rejecting Pisces.

journalPrompt: What am I ready to release from the shadow of Virgo, and what balance with Pisces is asking to be lived now?
tarotPrompt: What truth is this Virgo Full Moon revealing that I can no longer avoid?
